item.title: Trump started the Iran war with 5 goals. How far has he gotten?
item.summary: The president claimed he achieved them all. The reality is more complicated.

item.title: White House struggles to prop up truce marked by confusion, contradictions
item.summary: As the Trump administration claimed success, Tehran disputed the terms, shipping through the Strait of Hormuz remained stalled, and new questions emerged.

item.title: Trump officials unveil designs for president’s controversial 250-foot arch
item.summary: Military veterans have sued to halt the project, saying it would alter key views of Arlington National Cemetery.

item.title: Salvadoran teen convicted of assault for groping girls at Virginia high school
item.summary: A Fairfax High School administrative assistant testified in court that Israel Flores Ortiz, an 18-year-old junior at the school, admitted to the allegations.

item.title: U.S. negotiators to ask Iran to release detained Americans
item.summary: The request for the Americans’ release may be delayed if the talks between President Donald Trump’s team and Iran prove difficult, according to people briefed on the plans.

item.title: Eric Swalwell, California governor candidate, accused of sexual assault by ex-staffer
item.summary: Supporters of Rep. Eric Swalwell’s campaign withdrew support, including two congressmen who chaired his campaign and two senators who endorsed his bid. Swalwell denied the allegations.

item.title: Mapping where the redistricting fight stands and where it’s headed
item.summary: As Trump pushes for a more Republican-friendly House map, more than half a dozen states are potential targets for mid-decade tweaks to congressional boundaries.

item.title: Kamala Harris tells cheering crowd she’s ‘thinking about’ another White House run
item.summary: The former vice president’s statement at a Black political convention was one of her most explicit signals yet that she could campaign again for president in 2028.

item.title: Cardinal’s meeting at Pentagon was ‘unusual,’ Vatican official says
item.summary: U.S. and Vatican officials have sought to downplay accounts of a strained relationship, but there have been tensions between the Trump administration and the Catholic Church.

item.title: Is Chuck Schumer leaving his top candidate recruit twisting in the wind?
item.summary: Maine’s Democratic governor, Janet Mills, has gone negative against Graham Platner. The attacks have not worked, and Minority Leader Charles Schumer so far has declined to bail her out.
